package.description: Track and analyze the activity of your system COM ports.

en-US.description: Track and analyze the activity of your system COM ports.
en-US.longDescription:
Serial Port Monitor is a professional software application that allows reading and recording serial
data going through your computer’s serial ports. The program is a big help for those who develop
and debug software and hardware solutions that use COM ports for serial data transfer.
en-US.name: Serial Port Monitor
